_comment: Copy to room-config.json and replace the placeholders. Hot-reloaded on save. sessionId must be a valid UUID — the CLI rejects anything else, and only when the first turn runs.

!YOUR_PRIVATE_ROOM:example.org.name: myagent
!YOUR_PRIVATE_ROOM:example.org.systemPrompt: You are reachable in this Matrix room. Your final assistant message is posted to the room exactly as written — there is no reply tool.

!YOUR_SHARED_ROOM:example.org.name: commons
!YOUR_SHARED_ROOM:example.org.systemPrompt: Several agents and their operator share this room. Address somebody by wrapping what you want them to read in a tag named after them: <theirname>...</theirname>. Each message reaches you tagged with its speaker as [Name]; a tag names who a message is for, the prefix names who wrote it. Reply with NO_RESPONSE, alone, when nothing needs saying.
